title.narrative: Green and Renewable Energy Transition for Youth and Education - Joint SDG

description.narrative: The pilot and prototype model will provide needed interventions for the most vulnerable registered in school feeding programs. This will support SDG 7 target by converting the facility to a renewable energy model,introduce energy storage, promote clean cooking solutions for large scale production and present energy efficient appliance option. The overall initiative supports multiple Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs),notably Quality Education (SDG 4), Affordable and Clean Energy (SDG 7), Climate Action (SDG 13), and Sustainable Cities and Communities (SDG11). Integrating green skills training and renewable energy practices intoeducation systems is crucial for accelerating SDG transitions and activating key engine room actions essential for sustainable development. This cross-sectoral approach will increase knowledge product development between the Ministry of Education, Ministry ofYouth and Community Engagement as well as the Communication, Works and Energy Industries in pilot islands. Core to the implementation will beensuring inclusivity of marginalized groups, gender balance, and support for indigenous populations.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
